import contextlib
import io
import pytest
import sys

captured = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(captured), contextlib.redirect_stderr(captured):
    code = pytest.main(["-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "tests/test_jax_examples_one_to_one_tdd_receipts.py"])
text = captured.getvalue()
if code == 2 and "No module named 'examples.jax.tdd_receipts'" in text:
    print("missing replayable TDD receipt validator", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
if code == 0:
    raise SystemExit(0)
print("unexpected TDD receipt contract outcome", file=sys.stderr)
raise SystemExit(99)
